note: 十段连续变更编稿，未配音未发布；版本锁、目标平台、构建输入与回退制品一起验收，不填写音频时间轴。

series.title: Python依赖升级：锁定、重建与灰度验收
series.premise: 库存同步工具需升级HTTP客户端以采用维护中的版本；旧认证插件约束冲突，生产任务不能重复写入。
series.outcome: 升级兼容认证插件，按生产Python与平台解析带哈希锁文件，固定构建输入并核对两次干净重建；兼容、预演与灰度通过，验证旧制品可回退，无数据格式迁移。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 带哈希锁定的依赖清单

recycling.note: 以下仅未来场景候选，不算实际出现；本稿旧引用限p001-p350及自身早段。

dialogues.title: 为什么现在升级
dialogues.premise: 现有客户端分支将停止维护，提出受控升级申请。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住维护动机与不包含的功能变更。

lines.en: We need a supported release of the client. Our current branch loses maintenance next month.
lines.zh: 客户端需要换到受支持版本，当前分支下月停止维护。

lines.en: Is this maintenance or a feature rollout? Keep the approval scope explicit here.
lines.zh: 这是维护还是功能发布？明确审批范围。

lines.en: Maintenance only, no new inventory behavior. The authentication plugin may need upgrading too.
lines.zh: 只做维护，不改变库存行为，认证插件可能也需升级。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no schema migration, right? We need a reversible application change.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不改数据结构，对吧？应用变更要能回退。

lines.en: I'll define a smoke test for syncing. Include authentication, pagination, and duplicate write protection.
lines.zh: 我定义同步冒烟测试，覆盖认证、分页与防重复写入。

lines.en: One action item is checking transitive dependencies. What's the ETA for the test environment?
lines.zh: 一项任务是检查间接依赖，测试环境预计多久就绪？

lines.en: The environment is ready this afternoon. Use the production interpreter and base image.
lines.zh: 今天下午环境就绪，使用生产解释器和基础镜像。

lines.en: We'll request a maintenance window after testing. Maybe Thursday works for the service owner.
lines.zh: 测试后申请维护窗口，服务负责人可能周四方便。

lines.en: Don't approve the window as release permission. Evidence still needs review before production deployment.
lines.zh: 窗口获批不等于可以发布，上生产前仍要审查证据。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll confirm the inventory workload schedule. We shouldn't overlap the nightly reconciliation job.
lines.zh: 同意，我确认库存作业时间，不能与夜间对账重叠。

dialogues.title: 解析失败不是强装理由
dialogues.premise: 在生产匹配环境解析升级依赖，认证插件约束冲突。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分版本约束冲突与运行时问题。

lines.en: The dependency resolver rejects the proposed set. Our plugin requires the older client range.
lines.zh: 依赖解析器拒绝这组版本，插件要求旧客户端范围。

lines.en: Show both constraints in the review. Don't force installation by ignoring dependency checks.
lines.zh: 评审展示两边约束，不能忽略依赖检查强行安装。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is outdated plugin compatibility. A newer plugin advertises the required range.
lines.zh: 目前假设是插件兼容范围过时，新插件声明支持所需范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, advertised isn't tested, right? We'll verify behavior before accepting that pair.
lines.zh: 确认一下，声明支持不等于已测，对吧？接受这组版本前验证行为。

lines.en: Check interpreter requirements and available platform wheels. A solvable graph can still fail installation.
lines.zh: 检查解释器要求与平台wheel，版本图可解也可能安装失败。

lines.en: I'm on it for the candidate plugin. We can rule that out as network failure.
lines.zh: 候选插件我来查，可以排除这次解析失败是网络故障。

lines.en: Yes, the error cites incompatible version constraints. Keep the complete resolver output as evidence.
lines.zh: 对，错误明确指出版本约束不兼容，保留完整解析输出。

lines.en: Okay, the plugin itself handles token refresh. Maybe that path needs extra compatibility tests.
lines.zh: 好，插件本身处理令牌刷新，该路径可能需要额外兼容测试。

lines.en: A client replacement is another option. But it's outside this maintenance change's scope.
lines.zh: 换客户端也是选项，但超出本次维护变更范围。

lines.en: Let's park that larger replacement for now. Test the compatible pair without broadening scope.
lines.zh: 先放下大范围替换，测试兼容组合，不扩大范围。

dialogues.title: 锁版本也锁安装输入
dialogues.premise: 选择候选客户端和插件组合，解析生产平台的完整依赖。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别直接依赖固定与完整哈希锁定。

lines.en: We've generated hash-locked requirements for production. Direct and transitive versions are both fixed.
lines.zh: 已生成生产用带哈希锁依赖，直接与间接版本都固定了。

lines.en: Which interpreter and platform produced that lock? Keep those inputs under version control too.
lines.zh: 锁文件针对什么解释器和平台？这些输入也要版本管理。

lines.en: Python three twelve on our Linux image. Just to confirm, other platforms need validation, right?
lines.zh: Linux镜像上的Python 3.12，确认一下，其他平台另需验证，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, the dependency resolver output is attached. No hand-edited version exceptions in this approval.
lines.zh: 好，附上解析输出，本次审批不接受手工改版本例外。

lines.en: Check every artifact's hash during installation. Hashes verify identity, not package security alone.
lines.zh: 安装核对每个包的哈希，哈希验证身份，本身不证明包安全。

lines.en: I'm on it with the approved package mirror. Maybe we'll need to retain older wheels.
lines.zh: 批准的镜像源我来处理，可能也需保留旧wheel。

lines.en: Retain them for reproducible rollback builds. Pin the base image and installer version too.
lines.zh: 保留以便重建回退版本，也固定基础镜像与安装器。

lines.en: The lock becomes part of managed configuration. I'll stop production installs from resolving afresh.
lines.zh: 锁文件纳入受管配置，生产安装不能重新自由解析版本。

lines.en: Build inputs also include compiler toolchains. Prefer approved wheels where the platform supports them.
lines.zh: 构建输入还包括编译工具链，平台支持时优先批准的wheel。

lines.en: Make retaining inputs an explicit action item. The lock alone isn't our reproducibility claim.
lines.zh: 保留输入列为明确任务，不能只靠锁文件宣称可复现。

dialogues.title: 兼容测试覆盖真实调用
dialogues.premise: 依赖和构建输入锁定，开始验证客户端调用行为。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出刷新令牌、超时与分页为什么都在验收范围。

lines.en: The compatibility matrix covers our production interpreter. Authentication refresh, pagination, and timeout paths pass.
lines.zh: 兼容矩阵覆盖生产解释器，认证刷新、分页和超时路径通过。

lines.en: The supported release changes timeout exception types. I updated our explicit handling and tests.
lines.zh: 受支持版本改变了超时异常类型，我更新了显式处理和测试。

lines.en: Did the tests use real response shapes? Simplified mocks can hide pagination changes.
lines.zh: 测试使用真实响应结构吗？简化模拟可能掩盖分页变化。

lines.en: Yes, sanitized captured responses and contract fixtures. Just to confirm, no production tokens, right?
lines.zh: 是，用脱敏响应和契约用例。确认一下，没有生产令牌，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, credentials come from the test tenant. The smoke test checks the complete sync.
lines.zh: 对，凭据来自测试租户，冒烟测试检查完整同步。

lines.en: Okay, install using hash-locked requirements every time. We need the tested combination, not something similar.
lines.zh: 好，每次都按哈希锁安装，需要已测组合，不是类似组合。

lines.en: Check connection cleanup after cancelled requests too. Success paths won't expose leaked resources.
lines.zh: 也检查取消请求后的连接释放，只测成功路径发现不了泄漏。

lines.en: The cancellation tests now release their connections. We can rule that out in covered cases.
lines.zh: 取消测试现在会释放连接，可在已覆盖情况排除泄漏。

lines.en: Maybe large inventories still behave differently here. I'll add a representative multi-page dataset.
lines.zh: 大库存可能仍有不同表现，我增加有代表性的多页数据集。

lines.en: Agreed, keep untested combinations clearly excluded. Approval covers this interpreter and platform only.
lines.zh: 同意，明确排除未测组合，审批仅覆盖当前解释器和平台。

dialogues.title: 两次干净重建再预演
dialogues.premise: 兼容测试通过，验证构建可复现与非生产同步。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分依赖一致、镜像一致和业务预演成功。

lines.en: Each clean rebuild used the same inputs. Normalized build timestamps keep image outputs deterministic.
lines.zh: 两次干净重建输入相同，标准化构建时间戳让镜像输出确定。

lines.en: Both images match by digest and inventory. Hash-locked requirements installed without using local caches.
lines.zh: 两个镜像摘要与包清单一致，哈希锁依赖安装未用本地缓存。

lines.en: Matching package versions isn't sufficient by itself. Here the final artifact digests match too.
lines.zh: 仅包版本相同本身不够，这里最终制品摘要也相同。

lines.en: Okay, dry-run it first against test inventory. Just to confirm, writes stay disabled, right?
lines.zh: 好，先针对测试库存预演。确认一下，写入保持禁用，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, then isolated writes test real effects. The compatibility matrix includes duplicate request handling.
lines.zh: 是，随后隔离写入测试实际效果，兼容矩阵含重复请求处理。

lines.en: Maybe the cached build masked an issue before. These clean runs remove that particular uncertainty.
lines.zh: 之前缓存构建可能掩盖问题，这次干净重建消除了这项不确定性。

lines.en: The rehearsal must use the approved artifact. Don't rebuild a different image for deployment.
lines.zh: 预演必须用批准制品，部署不能另建不同镜像。

lines.en: We'll hold the go/no-go review after rehearsal. No production access before explicit approval.
lines.zh: 预演后做放行评审，明确批准前不访问生产。

lines.en: Isolated writes produced the expected inventory state. Replayed requests didn't create duplicate records.
lines.zh: 隔离写入产生预期库存状态，重放请求没有产生重复记录。

lines.en: Good, I'll attach those results for approval. The deployment still needs its rollback checks.
lines.zh: 好，我提交这些结果，部署仍需要回退检查。

dialogues.title: 只切一个同步分区
dialogues.premise: 预演通过，审批批准一个分区切换，旧制品已保留。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别防止新旧worker重复写入的切换顺序。

lines.en: Approve one canary cohort for this window. The staged rollout starts with one partition.
lines.zh: 本窗口批准一组灰度，分阶段发布从一个分区开始。

lines.en: Drain the old worker before assigning ownership. Two workers mustn't process the same partition.
lines.zh: 先排空旧worker再转移所有权，不能两个worker同时处理该分区。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the lease transfers once, right? I'll verify no overlapping writer remains.
lines.zh: 确认一下，租约只转移一次，对吧？我验证没有重叠写入者。

lines.en: Okay, keep an eye on reconciliation lag. Maybe the first batch warms connections slowly.
lines.zh: 好，关注对账延迟，首批连接预热可能较慢。

lines.en: The smoke test uses this production partition. Compare output counts with its expected inventory.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试针对这个生产分区，把输出计数与预期库存比较。

lines.en: The new worker holds the sole lease. Token refresh and the initial batch pass.
lines.zh: 新worker独占租约，令牌刷新和首批处理通过。

lines.en: State the rollback trigger before further batches. Duplicates or reconciliation mismatches mean immediate pause.
lines.zh: 继续批次前明确回退条件，重复记录或对账不符立即暂停。

lines.en: Agreed, pause and evaluate before reverting ownership. Don't start old workers beside new ones.
lines.zh: 同意，暂停评估后才恢复旧所有权，不能新旧worker并跑。

lines.en: First-batch counts and signatures match expectations. We'll inspect another full token-refresh cycle.
lines.zh: 首批计数与签名符合预期，再检查一个完整令牌刷新周期。

lines.en: I'll own that observation before expansion approval. Healthy startup alone doesn't cover steady-state behavior.
lines.zh: 扩大审批前由我负责观察，仅启动健康不能覆盖稳定运行。

dialogues.title: 警告与业务错误分开判断
dialogues.premise: 灰度运行稳定，日志出现弃用警告，需要判断影响。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出警告不等于故障，也不能无条件忽略。

lines.en: We've got one deprecation warning per startup. It references our legacy token callback.
lines.zh: 每次启动有一个弃用警告，指向旧令牌回调。

lines.en: Does it precede an actual authentication failure? Compare events across a full refresh cycle.
lines.zh: 之后有实际认证失败吗？跨完整刷新周期比较事件。

lines.en: The canary cohort refreshed tokens successfully twice. Our working hypothesis is future compatibility risk.
lines.zh: 灰度组已成功刷新两次，当前假设是未来兼容风险。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no failed writes, right? Keep the warning separate from error counts.
lines.zh: 确认一下，没有写入失败，对吧？警告与错误计数分开。

lines.en: Check when the callback will be removed. A warning still deserves an owned task.
lines.zh: 查回调何时被移除，警告仍需有人负责处理。

lines.en: Okay, that becomes my next action item. Maybe the replacement needs its own compatibility review.
lines.zh: 好，列为我的下一项任务，替代接口可能另需兼容评审。

lines.en: Current documentation confirms support in this release. Tests show successful refresh, not future guarantees.
lines.zh: 当前文档确认本版本仍支持，测试说明目前刷新成功，不保证未来。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on latency too. The steady-state comparison matches our previous baseline.
lines.zh: 我也关注延迟，稳定运行对比与旧基线一致。

lines.en: Record the observation period and sample size. Avoid claiming every workload is fully covered.
lines.zh: 记录观察时段和样本量，不宣称覆盖所有负载。

lines.en: Agreed, expansion waits for the review decision. The warning gets a deadline, not silence.
lines.zh: 同意，扩大要等评审决定，警告设期限，不直接静音。

dialogues.title: 推广同一个制品
dialogues.premise: 观察无业务回归，弃用警告已定责任与期限，批准逐批扩大。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住同制品、逐分区切换和每批检查。

lines.en: We'll promote the same artifact through batches. The review approves two more partitions first.
lines.zh: 各批推广同一个制品，评审先批准再扩大两个分区。

lines.en: Verify its digest before each deployment. A matching tag doesn't guarantee identical bytes.
lines.zh: 每次部署前验证摘要，同标签不保证字节相同。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no dependency resolution during deployment, right? We deploy the already-tested image only.
lines.zh: 确认一下，部署时不重新解析依赖，对吧？只部署已测镜像。

lines.en: The canary cohort remains our comparison group. Maybe regional latency needs separate thresholds here.
lines.zh: 灰度组保留作对照，区域延迟可能需要单独阈值。

lines.en: Yes, compare each partition with its baseline. Don't average a regional problem away.
lines.zh: 对，各分区与自身基线比，不能用平均值掩盖区域问题。

lines.en: Okay, the staged rollout retains exclusive leases. Each old worker drains before ownership moves.
lines.zh: 好，分阶段发布保持独占租约，转移所有权前旧worker排空。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation between batches. Stop expansion if reconciliation results diverge.
lines.zh: 各批之间观察，对账结果偏离就停止扩大。

lines.en: Run the smoke test for each batch. Anika signs off before the next one.
lines.zh: 每批做冒烟测试，Anika验收后才进入下一批。

lines.en: Both additional partitions match expected output. Their latency and token refresh remain healthy.
lines.zh: 新增两个分区输出符合预期，延迟和令牌刷新正常。

lines.en: I'll approve the remaining batches under those gates. No changes to the approved image.
lines.zh: 按这些关卡批准剩余批次，批准镜像不能改变。

dialogues.title: 旧镜像能否接回任务
dialogues.premise: 扩大完成无回归，在隔离环境复核旧版本回退兼容性。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区别保留镜像与完成回退验证。

lines.en: The previous image digest is retained locally. Its signature and retrieval path are verified.
lines.zh: 旧镜像摘要对应制品已保留，签名与取回路径验证通过。

lines.en: The clean rebuild record covers that image. But rollback uses retained bytes, not rebuilding.
lines.zh: 干净重建记录涵盖该镜像，但回退直接用留存制品，不临时重建。

lines.en: Can the old worker read current checkpoints? Image availability alone doesn't prove operational rollback.
lines.zh: 旧worker能读当前检查点吗？镜像可取不等于回退可用。

lines.en: Yes, checkpoint format stayed unchanged this time. Just to confirm, we tested that, right?
lines.zh: 可以，这次检查点格式未变。确认一下，已经测试，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, the smoke test passed after simulated rollback. No live production reversal is needed now.
lines.zh: 好，模拟回退后冒烟测试通过，现在不必反转生产。

lines.en: Maybe the callback replacement will change compatibility. We'll review it as a separate change.
lines.zh: 替换回调可能改变兼容性，会作为独立变更评审。

lines.en: Document draining before restoring the old lease. The rollback trigger must include duplicate writes.
lines.zh: 记录恢复旧租约前的排空步骤，回退触发必须包含重复写入。

lines.en: A temporary workaround would pause the partition. We'd preserve its checkpoint before any reversal.
lines.zh: 临时措施是暂停分区，任何反向切换前保留检查点。

lines.en: The isolated rollback preserved all processed records. Unprocessed records resumed without duplicate side effects.
lines.zh: 隔离回退保留已处理记录，未处理记录恢复时没有重复副作用。

lines.en: Good, keep the old artifact through retention. We can close deployment, not erase recovery options.
lines.zh: 好，按期限保留旧制品，可关闭部署，不能删除恢复选项。

dialogues.title: 记录可复现边界
dialogues.premise: 升级完成且回退复核通过，整理构建与运行记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清哪些输入固定、哪些组合未验证和遗留任务。

lines.en: Build provenance now records all pinned inputs. That includes interpreter, mirror snapshots, and toolchain.
lines.zh: 构建来源记录全部固定输入，包括解释器、镜像源快照和工具链。

lines.en: Attach final digests and comparison results. The reproducibility claim covers our tested platform only.
lines.zh: 附最终摘要与比较结果，可复现结论仅限已测平台。

lines.en: Hash-locked requirements live beside the build recipe. The compatibility matrix links to behavior tests.
lines.zh: 哈希锁依赖与构建步骤放一起，兼容矩阵链接行为测试。

lines.en: The deprecation warning has an action item. Raj owns the replacement next sprint, right?
lines.zh: 弃用警告已设行动项，Raj下个迭代负责替换，对吧？

lines.en: Keep approval and rollback records linked too. An engineer should retrieve the exact previous artifact.
lines.zh: 也关联审批与回退记录，工程师应能取回准确旧制品。

lines.en: Yes, maybe one sprint for the replacement. I'll estimate after reviewing the new callback.
lines.zh: 是，替换可能需一个迭代，审查新回调后再估算。

lines.en: Don't generalize success to untested interpreter versions. Those need their own locks and validation.
lines.zh: 不能把成功推广到未测解释器版本，它们需要独立锁与验证。

lines.en: Okay, I'll close the loop with operations. They have the stop and recovery procedures.
lines.zh: 好，我与运维确认闭环，他们已经拿到停止和恢复流程。

lines.en: The retained artifacts have a named owner. Expiry reminders prevent accidental loss before review.
lines.zh: 留存制品有明确负责人，到期提醒避免评审前误丢。

lines.en: Agreed, deployment is complete with follow-up tracked. Next sprint we'll review the callback replacement.
lines.zh: 同意，部署完成，遗留改进持续跟踪，下个迭代评审回调替换。
